children: Regan McMillan McGee disclosed a 44.9% stake in MBody AI Ltd., the Nasdaq-listed company formerly known as Check-Cap Ltd. The position stems from the Aug. 26, 2026 merger that converted his MBody AI Corp. shares into MBody AI Ltd. ordinary shares. McGee serves as chairman of the board, signaling significant influence over the company’s direction.

McGee plans to monitor his investment and could buy more shares, hold, or sell depending on his review of MBody AI Ltd.’s performance and opportunities. He also highlights his role in governance: "Mr. McGee serves as the Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Issuer."

For now, he does not outline specific transactions or corporate changes. As stated in the filing, he has "no present plans or proposals" for actions like mergers, asset sales, or changes in control, though he may revisit his plans over time.

Regan McMillan McGee is a Canadian investor who chairs the board of MBody AI Ltd. He is also the chairman and chief executive officer of Apollo Technology Capital Corporation, an investment and governance platform focused on founder-led companies. McGee’s approach centers on building and guiding operating businesses while maintaining flexibility to adjust positions as conditions change.
